issue: Source is NHS 111 Wales, but the text says 'The UK’s NHS'. The NHS is four separate systems, and the place should match the cited page. Figure (11) is verbatim.
suggestedText: NHS Wales gives 11 as the average age for girls to start puberty.

issue: Figure confirmed in ms2.xls (1990, women, 23.9). But MS-2 is an estimated median age at first marriage. 'The median American woman married for the first time at 23.9' reads as a statement about all women, including those who never married.
suggestedText: In 1990 the median age at first marriage for US women was 23.9, Census Bureau estimates show.

issue: Abstract confirmed (3,305 players aged 16-44; slowing begins at 24). The study is cross-sectional, comparing players of different ages at one time. 'Their in-game responses began to slow' implies each player was tracked as they aged. Use the paper's framing.
suggestedText: In a study of 3,305 StarCraft 2 players aged 16 to 44, age-related slowing of in-game response times began at 24.
